criteria_results.text: While a desktop-originated chat is open on mobile, new desktop user and assistant turns appear automatically without a manual refresh.
criteria_results.notes: The user retried with the exact PR desktop artifact on corrective commit cdd0bb465, API and engine health both HTTP 200, and the existing physical-iPhone dev client still connected to Metro. Desktop-originated turns still did not appear in the already-open mobile transcript without refresh.

process_issues.description: The corrective commit was pushed and handed to physical-device smoke after local verification without waiting for the new commit's GitHub CI run.
process_issues.detected_by: Transcript tool-call review: git push was followed by artifact launch and smoke handoff, with no gh run watch between them.

failure_output: User after corrective artifact retry: fail. Previous observation: mobile messages and responses show live on desktop, but desktop-authored messages do not stream live to mobile and require refresh.
suggested_follow_up: Issue #1287 should trace one physical-device desktop event across engine SSE, authenticated gateway SSE, mobile EventSource receipt, session-ID matching, refresh scheduling, and React state commit; the current server-only live contract is a false proxy for the device behavior.
